caseno: CRIMINAL PETITION FOR LEAVE TO APPEAL NO.10 OF 1995
lawyer: For the petitioner : Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate on Record, Supreme Court. Respondents : Not represented.
parties:
Md. Mofizuddin ------ complainant-Petitioner.
Versus
Abul kalam and others ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 3. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record for the petitioner, submitted that the engaged lawyer of the petitioner supplied wrong information that the case was fixed for evidence on 19-7-94 and due to such wrong information the petitioner failed to appear on 17-9-94 and that the trial Magistrate without applying his judicial mind as to the offence alleged to have been committed by the respondents under section 386 of the penal code failed to exercise his judicial discretion to adjourn the hearing of the case in the interest of justice and wrongly acquitted them under section 247 Cr. P. C. and as such the learned judges of the High court division improperly dismissed the appeal summarily by the impugned judgment and order.
